services.name: Sun Tracker 22’ Tritoon
services.desc: Cruise in comfort aboard our Sylvan Tritoon, equipped with a smooth and dependable Yamaha 150HP engine. With triple pontoons for added stability and a spacious, well-designed layout, this boat is perfect for relaxing, swimming, and exploring Anna Maria Island and beyond. Designed for experienced boaters, this tritoon offers an easy, stable ride and all the features needed for a full day—or several—on the water. Whether you’re anchoring at a sandbar or spending quality time with friends and family, this boat delivers a safe and enjoyable experience. ✅ Comfortably seats around 10 people ✅ Triple pontoon design for extra stability ✅ Yamaha 150HP – quiet, reliable, and fuel-efficient ✅

services.name: Sun Tracker 22’ Tritoon - Captained Tours
services.desc: Sylvan Tritoon – Captained Tours Sit back, relax, and enjoy the water aboard our Sylvan Tritoon, powered by a smooth and dependable Yamaha 150HP engine and operated by one of our licensed local captains. With its triple-pontoon design, spacious seating, and ultra-stable ride, this tritoon is the perfect platform for sightseeing, swimming, and exploring Anna Maria Island and surrounding waters. Our captained tours are designed for guests who want a stress-free, premium experience on the water. Whether you’re cruising the Intracoastal, visiting local sandbars, spotting dolphins, or enjoying a sunset cruise, this boat offers comfort, safety, and plenty of room to spread out and enjoy the day.
